2610.01728.title: Removing spurious minima for planar features by skip connections
2610.01728.paper_summary: Understanding loss landscapes is central to explaining neural-network training, yet their structure remains only partially understood even in simple models. We study the Gaussian population loss of shallow, bias-free ReLU networks in the teacher--student setting. This provides a simple model for studying essential aspects such as feature learning and overparameterization. For teacher networks with positive output weights and planar features, we show that including a learned linear skip removes all spurious local minima with non-negative student output weights once the student network is at least as wide as the teacher network. In contrast, without the skip, we construct a fixed teacher network with positive output weights and only three hidden neurons in input dimension two whose spurious local minima persist at every student width at least three. Thus, a learned linear skip can remove spurious minima that persist under arbitrary overparameterization. Furthermore, we show that a positive output weight student network always learns the subspace spanned by the teacher features: student features at local minima with non-negative student output weights lie in the span of the teacher features. For ReLU networks in two dimensions, even heavily overparameterized student networks have effective width controlled by the teacher width: every critical point with positive student output weights has at most twice as many distinct student feature directions as teacher neurons. Finally, we transfer the benignity result to empirical minima over parameter balls of any prescribed radius, with the required sampling accuracy depending on that radius.
2610.01728.paper_summary_zh: 理解損失景觀對於解釋神經網絡訓練至關重要，然而即使在簡單模型中，其結構仍然只有部分被理解。<lb/>我們研究了教師-學生設定中淺層無偏ReLU網絡的高斯族群損失。<lb/>這提供了一個簡單的模型來研究特徵學習和過度參數化等基本方面。<lb/>對於具有正輸出權重和平面特徵的教師網絡，我們顯示，包含一個學習的線性跳躍可以消除所有具有非負學生輸出權重的虛假局部最小值，前提是學生網絡的寬度至少與教師網絡一樣寬。<lb/>相反，若沒有跳躍，我們構造了一個固定的教師網絡，其具有正輸出權重，並且在輸入維度為二的情況下只有三個隱藏神經元，其虛假局部最小值在每個學生寬度至少為三的情況下持續存在。<lb/>因此，學習的線性跳躍可以消除在任意過度參數化下持續存在的虛假最小值。<lb/>此外，我們顯示，正輸出權重的學生網絡總是學習由教師特徵所張成的子空間：在具有非負學生輸出權重的局部最小值處，學生特徵位於教師特徵的張成範圍內。<lb/>對於二維的ReLU網絡，即使是過度參數化的學生網絡，其有效寬度也受到教師寬度的控制：每個具有正學生輸出權重的臨界點最多有兩倍於教師神經元的不同學生特徵方向。<lb/>最後，我們將良性結果轉移到任何指定半徑的參數球上的經驗最小值，所需的取樣精度取決於該半徑。
